reason: Release proposal v001 for candidate 2a04e49 (local-pilot): users can change each task's status from a labelled, keyboard-operable Status control; the filter and count update immediately and changes persist in the browser under a new key, task-list:status:v1, with stars untouched. Review and verification found AC1-AC8 met with no deviations; the two informational review notes need no action. The proposal includes a pre-merge checklist, 12 smoke checks (change, filter, keyboard, reload, corrupt-storage) and a revert-based rollback that needs no data migration.
